{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Strip commas from revenue and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
df_clean = df[df['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Verify removal
print(f"Number of rows after removing QA orders: {len(df_clean)}")
assert len(df_clean) == 894, "Expected 894 rows after removing 6 QA orders"

# Filter for NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH
filtered_df = df_clean[(df_clean['customer_segment'] == 'new') & (df_clean['channel'] == 'paid_search')]

# Compute conversion rate: fraction of converted orders
n_total = len(filtered_df)
n_converted = filtered_df['converted'].sum()
conversion_rate = n_converted / n_total

# Output
print(f"Total NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH (after removing QA): {n_total}")
print(f"Converted: {n_converted}")
print(f"Conversion rate: {conversion_rate:.4f}")"}
